summary: Tested the Shitja vendore warranty changes: 0/'Pa garanci' option in the warranty picker, 'Pa garanci' as the untouched default, retail-only A4 warranty terms, the 'Ruaj & Printo A4' button and the warranty-terms settings endpoint. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed (9 new + 8 regression from iteration_9). Frontend: every requested flow verified end-to-end with Playwright. No bugs found.

issues: Terms font is 8.5px, legible but very small when printed (needed to fit on one A4 page; acceptable)
Heading detection is a heuristic: any all-caps line is printed bold (e.g. a custom line typed in all caps). Expected behaviour.

critical_code_review_comments: PrintSalePage always calls window.print() on load; the ?auto=1 param is never read (harmless, since it auto-printed before too)
Backend labels warranty_days=0 as '0 ditë' internally, but a label is only stored when days>0, so nothing leaks to the output
server.py is 1660+ lines; consider splitting into routers
seed_data_creation: TEST_UIW_* products and their sales were created and then deleted. The settings key 'warranty_terms' was deleted, so the default text is back.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: trigger default 'Pa garanci'; menu has '0 · Pa garanci'; days grid 0..100 (101 buttons), 0 resets to 'Pa garanci'; 12 month options. Status text correct for retail+warranty, wholesale and no-warranty cases. Untouched warranty on a phone (product default 12m) gives warranty_until null and empty terms. Retail + 10 days print shows the terms block with bold headings, the edited per-sale text and Shitësi/Blerësi lines. Wholesale + 3 months and retail + day 0 show no terms block. Ruaj & Printo A4 navigates to /print/sale/<id>?format=a4&auto=1 and calls window.print once. Mbyll goes to /sales. Ruaj goes to /sales. Admin save of terms persists across reload. Employee gets 403 on PUT, anonymous gets 401/403.
